rules.content:
index=core_banking sourcetype=wire_transfer
| lookup customer_demographics account_id OUTPUT date_of_birth
| eval customer_age=round((now() - strptime(date_of_birth, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400 / 365.25, 0)
| where customer_age >= 60
| eval is_new_recipient=if(recipient_first_seen > relative_time(now(), "-30d"), 1, 0)
| where is_new_recipient=1
| stats count as wire_count, sum(amount) as total_amount, dc(recipient_id) as unique_recipients by account_id, customer_age
| where total_amount > 10000 OR wire_count > 3
| table account_id, customer_age, wire_count, total_amount, unique_recipients
| sort - total_amount
rules.title: Splunk -- Elder Customer Unusual Wire Transfer Pattern (Phase 4)

rules.content:
title: Remote Access Tool Detected During Elder Customer Online Banking Session
status: experimental
description: Detects active remote access tool processes (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, etc.) during online banking sessions for customers aged 60+.
logsource:
    product: online_banking
    service: session_analytics
detection:
    selection_session:
        customer_age|gte: 60
    selection_rat:
        active_processes|contains:
            - 'anydesk'
            - 'teamviewer'
            - 'logmein'
            - 'ultraviewer'
            - 'supremo'
    condition: selection_session and selection_rat
level: high
tags:
    - cfpf.phase2.initial_access
    - elder.exploitation
rules.title: Sigma -- Remote Access Tool Installation on Elder Customer Device (Phase 2)
